title: Droid (Factory AI)
description: Factory AI Droid CLI (https://docs.factory.ai). Config home HARDCODED to ~/.factory/ on mac/linux and %USERPROFILE%\.factory\ on Windows per Factory docs — NO documented Factory env override for the config dir itself. Factory-documented env vars (NOT config-dir overrides): FACTORY_API_KEY (authentication credential per Factory auth docs) and DROID_PLUGIN_ROOT (per Factory plugin docs, expanded INSIDE plugin hooks.json command strings — e.g. '${DROID_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/format.sh' resolves to the plugin dir when the hook runs; NOT a general CLI env override). The FACTORY_HOME entry under configHome.env is gsd-core-local plumbing that redirects GSD-managed installer writes only — Factory CLI itself does NOT recognise it, only AUTH (FACTORY_API_KEY) and PLUGIN-INTERIOR (DROID_PLUGIN_ROOT) are real per Factory docs. Hook events on settings.json keys use the Claude dialect (SessionStart, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Notification, UserPromptSubmit, Stop, SubagentStop, PreCompact, SessionEnd) per Factory hooks-reference. Slash invocations: BOTH routes emitted by GSD — modern ~/.factory/skills/<name>/SKILL.md per Factory 'merged custom slash commands into skills' (slash-invocable via /name AND model-invocable), AND existing-files ~/.factory/commands/<name>.md per Factory slash-commands doc (verbatim from doc: 'Your existing .factory/commands/ files continue to work unchanged. For new commands, consider using skills instead'). Both files coexist; Factory prefers the modern skills/ entry when both resolve. Subagent droids live at ~/.factory/droids/<name>.md (flat .md files, YAML frontmatter per Factory droid doc). GSD writes hook registrations to settings.json ONLY (not settings.local.json — that overlay is reserved for per-machine, uncommitted preferences per Factory settings docs). Tier-2 support (parity eligibility, not primary).
